The example's Android in-game integration pattern is the reference for
Amethisty's MenuLayer hook, Cocos menu button, and custom layer. Its original
32-bit binaries and old hard-coded patch addresses are not used as-is; code is
being adapted for Geometry Dash 2.2.145 arm64-v8a.
